note: Light travels in from screen left, passes through the glass at centre, and exits as smoke toward screen right. Shares the seed of loopcom-signal-through-glass so the change reads as direction, not a fresh roll.
prompt: An eight-second vertical film shot on a long macro lens with shallow depth of field. A thick slab of clear glass stands upright at the centre of the frame in deep navy darkness. From the left edge of the frame a luminous ribbon of mint and cyan light travels slowly rightward toward the glass, rippling and turbulent. The camera holds steady with a very slow push-in. The light enters the left face of the glass and refracts inside into fine parallel threads. Out of the right face it emerges as slow volumetric smoke, lit from within in mint and cyan, unfurling in soft billowing curls that drift onward toward the right edge of the frame. Volumetric light blooms through the glass and soft caustics fall to its right. Fine particles hang in the air catching the light.
